articles.title: Game 154, Red Sox at Rays lineups and notes: Boston’s magic number is three
articles.description: Ranger Suarez is on the mound, having allowed just one run over 14 innings in his last two starts.

articles.title: ‘I want to say something I can’t say’: Willson Contreras, knocked out with bruised hand, is tired of getting hit
articles.description: The Sox slugger was hit on the right hand on a pitch by Rangers reliever Jakob Junis in the eighth inning of Boston's 4-3 victory.

articles.title: Will this be the year the Red Sox get past the Yankees and advance in the playoffs? And other thoughts.
articles.description: It’s virtually certain that the Sox are bound for a best-of-three Wild Card Series at Yankee Stadium starting a week from Tuesday.

articles.title: Trevor Story’s three-run homer carries Red Sox to comeback win over Rangers
articles.description: Story's eighth-inning drive was his first homer since May 13, and gave Boston its 37th comeback win this season.

articles.title: Pinkie injury may be affecting Caleb Durbin, but it’s not keeping him out of Red Sox lineup
articles.description: Durbin dislocated his left pinkie on June 24, then reinjured it on Aug. 6.

articles.title: Roman Anthony hasn’t hit well since his hot Red Sox return. He insists he’s ‘where I want to be.’
articles.description: His lengthy IL stint ending in August means he's had time to acquire plate appearances ahead of his first postseason. He was sidelined last October with injury.

articles.title: Game 153: Red Sox at Rangers lineups and notes
articles.description: The Sox are looking to avoid a sweep down in Texas.

articles.title: ‘Sometimes, it doesn’t matter how hard we work’: Red Sox toil offensively again in second consecutive loss to Rangers
articles.description: The Boston offense continue to be anemic, posting just three hits, allowing host Texas to rally for the victory.

articles.title: Red Sox’ postseason pinch-runner role is ‘an important piece.’ Who can do it?
articles.description: With Eli White likely out of the picture, the Red Sox could turn to Jarren Duran or even Braiden Ward as a speedster off the bench in the postseason.

articles.title: The Red Sox took great pains to build depth in the offseason, and the results are paying off
articles.description: The Red Sox' season was saved by little-known players who emerged to play key roles.

articles.title: Game 152: Red Sox at Rangers lineups and notes
articles.description: Jake Bennett will be on the mound when the Red Sox continue their road trip in Texas. Their magic number remains at five.

articles.title: Patrick Sandoval, Red Sox come up short vs. Rangers, leaving magic number to clinch playoff berth at five
articles.description: Sandoval allowed four runs on four hits in a truncated 2⅔ innings of work in the series-opening loss in Arlington, Texas.

articles.title: Red Sox reliever Justin Slaten to miss rest of season with ‘degenerative’ arm issue
articles.description: Before series opener against the Rangers, Slaten and Sox medical staff visited Keith Meister, a highly regarded orthopedic and sports medicine surgeon based in Arlington.

articles.title: Game 151, Red Sox at Rangers lineups and notes: Magic number is down to five
articles.description: Patrick Sandoval will be on the mound when the Red Sox open a three-game series at Texas.

articles.title: Aaron Judge hits first home run since May 24 as Yankees clinch postseason berth
articles.description: Judge, who returned last week after missing more than three months because of a fractured rib, hit a three-run homer off A.J. Minter.

articles.title: Deep down, Garrett Whitlock doesn’t think his career as a starting pitcher is over
articles.description: But Whitlock is a realist: The Sox’ rotation seems full for the foreseeable future, and he can make more of an impact as a reliever.
